WelcomeOffline: Offline · type /apikey sk-… to connect DeepSeek
WelcomeIntro: Type a message to start · / for commands · Ctrl+C to quit
ApprovalNoSandbox: NO sandbox confinement on this host
PickerHelpStartup: ↑/↓ select · Enter resume · n/Esc new session · Ctrl+C quit
ComposerPlaceholderSteering: Type to queue a follow-up for when this turn ends…
CompletionMenuTitle: Complete: ↑/↓ select | Tab/Enter accept | Esc close
StatusSteeringQueued: Queued ({count}) — sends when the current turn finishes
StatusSteeringQueueFull: Queue full ({count}) — draft kept; wait for the turn to finish
StatusCancelling: Cancelling turn... (takes effect at the next tool boundary)
SystemSaveFailed: ⚠ Session save failed; this conversation is not persisted: {error}
FindExhausted: Reached the earliest match for "{query}" · /find again restarts from the bottom
BusyRelaunchConfig: Streaming or awaiting approval; retry the config change later
SessionReloadFailedRestart: Could not reload the current session; restarted with a new one
BusySwitchSession: Streaming or awaiting approval; cannot switch sessions
StatusPickSession: Pick a session to resume (↑/↓ · Enter · Esc cancel)
StatusResumeCancelled: Cancelled; staying in the current session
SessionStoreOpenFailed: Could not open the session store: {error}
BusyNewConversation: Streaming or awaiting approval; cannot start a new conversation
StatusNewConversation: New conversation started (/resume recovers the old one)
HintClear: Start a new conversation: reset context and clear the screen (/resume recovers the old one)
HintApikey: Set the DeepSeek API key and connect
HintLogout: Clear the API key and go offline
HintCopy: Copy the last assistant reply to the clipboard
HintResume: Pick a past session (or type an <id>)
HintFind: Search the transcript for <keyword> (repeat to search upward)
ModelSwitched: Model switched to {model} (written to the global config). Backend: {backend}
LogoutDone: API key cleared; back to offline mode. /apikey sk-xxx reconnects.
HelpKeys: Keys: Enter send, Alt+Enter/Ctrl+J newline, ↑↓ scroll chat (moves the cursor inside a multi-line draft), Ctrl+P/Ctrl+N history, Ctrl+W delete word, Ctrl+U/K kill line, Ctrl+A/E line start/end, Esc cancel turn/clear input/quit (deny in the approval panel), Ctrl+C cancel/clear/press twice to quit, Shift+↑/↓ or PageUp/PageDown scroll the transcript (mouse drag selects and copies), y/a/n approve, ↑↓ + Enter in the approval panel.
HelpNoteCancel: Note: cancellation takes effect at tool boundaries — a synchronous tool that is already running finishes first. 'a' allows shell by program name for this session (e.g. cargo/git; compound commands still prompt each time).
HelpNoteAutoAllow: Config [approval] auto_allow pre-approves tool prefixes (env or global config only; the project file is ignored).
RestoreOutsideRuntime: Cannot restore outside the async runtime
LangSwitched: UI language set to English (written to the global config)
ErrMissingApiKey:
Missing DeepSeek API key; set the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable, or get one at https://platform.deepseek.com
1. Register and create an API key at https://platform.deepseek.com
2. export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-...
3. If your network to DeepSeek is unstable, try a proxy or mirror endpoint (deep-code defaults to https://api.deepseek.com/beta)
ErrHttp:
HTTP request failed: {error}
Could not reach DeepSeek — check your network, proxy settings, or the DeepSeek endpoint; configure a working proxy if your connection is unstable.
ErrApiUnauthorized: API authentication failed ({status}): confirm DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is correct and unexpired, and that the endpoint is DeepSeek-compatible. Original message: {message}
ErrApiRateLimited: API rate limited ({status}): retry later, or switch to Flash / enable auto cost-first to reduce load. Original message: {message}
ErrApiServer: DeepSeek service temporarily unavailable ({status}): retry later; auto mode will try downgrading Pro→Flash on retriable failures. Original message: {message}
ErrParse: Failed to parse the provider response: {detail}
ErrRequestTimeout:
Request timed out: no DeepSeek response headers within {seconds}s
Network or DeepSeek is slow — retry, or raise provider.timeout_secs.
ErrStreamStalled:
Stream stalled: no new data for {seconds}s
Network may be stalling or the proxy dropped — retry; for genuinely long tasks raise DEEP_CODE_STREAM_CHUNK_TIMEOUT_SECS.
ErrStreamDeadline:
Stream exceeded the {seconds}s total deadline
This turn ran too long and was terminated — split the task and retry, or raise DEEP_CODE_STREAM_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_SECS.
ErrStreamOverflow:
Stream too large: content exceeded the {limit}-byte cap
The response was unusually huge and was truncated for safety — narrow the task, or raise DEEP_CODE_STREAM_MAX_BYTES.
WebSearchRequestError: Search request failed (a proxy may be required): {error}
WebSearchNoResults: No search results parsed: no matches, or DuckDuckGo's page layout changed
WebClientInitError: Failed to initialize the HTTP client: {error}
WebSchemeNotAllowed: Unsupported scheme '{scheme}': only http/https are allowed
WebPrivateHostBlocked: Refused to fetch {host} (non-public address): private/loopback targets are not allowed
WebPrivateResolvedBlocked: Refused to fetch {host} (resolves to non-public {addr}): private/loopback targets are not allowed
CfgFileUnusable: Config file {path} is unusable and was skipped: {detail}
CfgProjectApiKeyIgnored: provider.api_key in the project config is ignored: the key may only come from the environment or global config, to avoid leaking through the repo or being injected by a malicious one
CfgProjectBaseUrlIgnored: provider.base_url in the project config is ignored ({url}): the endpoint may only come from the environment or global config, so a malicious repo cannot redirect your API key and full context to its own server
CfgUnknownReasoning: {layer} config has an unrecognized provider.reasoning_effort='{value}'; ignored
CfgProjectFieldIgnored: {field} in the project config is not whitelisted; ignored
CfgUnknownCurrency: {layer} config has an unrecognized cost.currency='{value}'; ignored
CfgProjectAutoAllowIgnored: approval.auto_allow in the project config is ignored: a repo must not disarm approval gates (prevents a malicious repo from silently allowing write/network tools)
CfgGlobalKeyPerms: Global config {path} holds api_key but is group/other-readable; run chmod 600
CfgApiKeyEmpty: API key is empty: usage /apikey sk-xxxx
CfgApiKeyWhitespace: API key must not contain whitespace; check what you pasted
CfgApiKeyTooShort: API key looks too short; check the paste is complete

SafetyRedirectReason: Redirection will write to or overwrite a file
SafetyRedirectSuggestion: Confirm the target file may be overwritten
SafetyPathOutsideReason: May read/write paths outside the workspace
SafetyPathOutsideSuggestion: Confirm the path is necessary; prefer workspace-relative paths
SafetyNetworkReason: Will make network access, possibly up/downloading data
SafetyNetworkSuggestion: Confirm the target host and transferred content are trusted
SafetyDeleteSuggestion: Confirm the deletion target is correct
SafetyChmodReason: Will change file permissions or ownership
SafetyChmodSuggestion: Confirm the permission change is necessary
SafetyGitRemoteReason: git remote operations exchange code with external repos
SafetyGitRemoteSuggestion: Confirm the remote address; avoid pushing to unknown repos
SafetyInstallReason: Installing dependencies downloads and runs third-party code
SafetyInstallSuggestion: Confirm the dependency source is trusted
EchoOfflineHint: No DeepSeek API key configured: type /apikey sk-... to connect now, or set the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable and restart.
RouteFixedModelPassthrough: Fixed model config: {model} (not in the catalog, used as-is)
RouteCascade: Cascade upgrade: Flash tool calls kept failing this session, handing off to Pro
RouteContextPressure: Context ~{percent}% used (≥{threshold}% threshold), using Pro for the long context
RouteKeywordDeep: Matched a debug/error keyword "{keyword}", using Pro with deep reasoning
RouteKeywordHeavy: Matched a complex-task keyword "{keyword}", using Pro for stronger reasoning and tool planning
RouteKeywordBorderline: Task contains "{keyword}" and cost-first is off, using Pro
RouteFlashDefault: Defaulting to Flash (faster, cheaper); cascade upgrades to Pro if tool calls keep failing
RouteFallbackProToFlash: DeepSeek temporarily unavailable or rate-limited; auto-downgraded Pro→Flash and retried
PermModeYoloArm: ⚠ Press Shift+Tab again to enter YOLO (auto-approve everything; hard denials still block); any other key cancels
